PROJECTS

Two automations, built and running

Real scenarios built in Make.com — not mockups.

PROJECT 01

Automated Lead Management System

A no-code lead automation workflow designed to collect, process and organize lead information automatically.

Lead / Form Input→ Make.com→ Data Processing→ Google Sheets→ Notification
Make.com Google Forms Google Sheets Gmail Filters Data Mapping
View Workflow →

Leads submitted through a Google Form are watched by Make.com in real time, processed and mapped into a structured Google Sheets row, then routed to trigger a follow-up email — cutting manual entry and response delay out of the loop.

PROJECT 02

AI-Powered Automation Workflow

An AI-powered automation workflow that demonstrates how business data can move between applications and AI services with minimal manual intervention.

Input→ Make.com→ AI / Gemini→ Router / Logic→ Sheets / Gmail
Make.com AI / Gemini Google Sheets Gmail Routers Webhooks Data Mapping
View Workflow →

Incoming enquiries are read by Gemini AI, which generates a summary and a recommended automation for each lead. A router then sends the result to the right Gmail reply based on the type of enquiry — service, follow-up, or support.
